snippet.title: RAISE-A-WISH Game PV - An Alternative Phase Invaders Story
snippet.description:
COMING SOON.

A daughter raising visual novel project inspired by titles like Princess Maker and Tamagotchi where you play as an unnamed protagonist to raise a member of Phase Invaders Wish.

Illustration: Roozuchan
https://x.com/roozuka
MV: Dex
https://x.com/mdxtr24
BGM: Xeliosphere
https://x.com/liosphe

& Special Thank you to Phase Connect for making this project possible.
